## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `<feature|fix|chore|doc>/<short-description>`
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behavior
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` pass locally
- [ ] **No secrets** (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) in code, tests, docs or this description
- [ ] New environment variables documented in `.env.example` (names only) and the README
- [ ] OpenAPI spec / README updated if behavior changed
